notes.title: Quick fixes 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, This update has the following changes

-Fixed a bug where the game started in German
-Fixed a bug with reflections in the main menu
-Fixed a bug with the character's jump animation
-Optimized some traps in room 3

Thank you all who play, I'll be glad to hear your feedback

notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone[/b], A month after the demo version, the game was released, I am very grateful to everyone who supported me and was interested in the game, now there is a 15% discount, I will be glad to hear your feedback, it will help me a lot for this and the following games, In the future, updates are possible, also if the players like the game, I will release an update, with [b]MULTIPLAYER[/b], everyone enjoy the game, visit our discord channel, I will be glad to see you there all the latest news on my games

[p][/p][previewyoutube="sTpc4TmEN7k;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][b]Hello everyone[/b] Today I released a gameplay trailer for the game, which means that the game will be available for sale very soon, I plan to release it at the end of the month or early September, so don't miss it, who hasn't had time to get acquainted with the game yet, the demo version will be available all the time, and thank you for your support,[/h3][p][b]PLACE[/b] is also my very old idea that I decided to implement, I was inspired by the [b]film (SYMBOL)[/b][/p][p]I think I managed to convey the mood, and make it atmospheric, I will be glad to receive your feedback, also visit my discord channel, there is more news, and we can chat

notes.title: Demo version
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone, today the demo version is available. I will be interested in your feedback, this is something new, I haven't made horrors and puzzles for a long time, I want another game like this in my portfolio
[/b]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3824650/PLACE_Demo"][/dynamiclink]
You are a random person trapped in an empty \[b]concrete room\[/b] under the watchful eye of a camera. The only way out is to risk pressing the forbidden button, after which more \[b]buttons\[/b] appear. Each press brings you closer to the exit or to your demise.

If you like this idea, add it to your wishlist and follow the development in my discord channel[/p]
